name: Prince Zale
source:
Zale is a selfish prince who has a strong sense of intuition and acts quickly. He has an exceedingly strong spirit in magic, hand-to-hand combat, and wisdom. He is from fire magic lineage, so fire magic is his strong point. He is the fourth prince out of seven, but is the direct descendant of the Demon King because the other princes, his siblings, have died. Curious about the human world, he decides to leave his castle to search out a the "White Soul" of a human.
